commit.message: release: add Pitari encrypted source part 03

data.name: Create ephemeral source-transfer key
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /tmp/pitari-cm-private.pem >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl pkey -in /tmp/pitari-cm-private.pem -pubout -out /tmp/pitari-cm-public.pem
PUB=$(base64 < /tmp/pitari-cm-public.pem | tr -d '\n')
echo "PITARI_TRANSFER_ID=${CM_BUILD_ID}"
echo "PITARI_PUBLIC_KEY_B64=${PUB}"
echo "PITARI_SOURCE_STATE=WAITING"

data.name: Receive and decrypt Pitari source
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR"
ROOT="pitari-bridge/${CM_BUILD_ID}"
READY=0
for n in $(seq 1 180); do
  git fetch origin release/pitari-testflight-direct-20260830 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  if git cat-file -e "origin/release/pitari-testflight-direct-20260830:${ROOT}/ready.json" 2>/dev/null; then READY=1; break; fi
  sleep 5
done
test "$READY" = 1
git show "origin/release/pitari-testflight-direct-20260830:${ROOT}/ready.json" > /tmp/pitari-ready.json
PART_COUNT=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/tmp/pitari-ready.json'))['part_count'])")
EXPECTED_SHA=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/tmp/pitari-ready.json'))['tar_sha256'])")
test "$PART_COUNT" -gt 0
: > /tmp/pitari-source.b64
for n in $(seq 0 $((PART_COUNT-1))); do
  P=$(printf '%02d' "$n")
  git show "origin/release/pitari-testflight-direct-20260830:${ROOT}/source.part${P}" >> /tmp/pitari-source.b64
done
git show "origin/release/pitari-testflight-direct-20260830:${ROOT}/key.b64" | base64 -d > /tmp/pitari-key.enc
base64 -d /tmp/pitari-source.b64 > /tmp/pitari-source.enc
openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey /tmp/pitari-cm-private.pem -in /tmp/pitari-key.enc -out /tmp/pitari-keyiv.bin -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:oaep -pkeyopt rsa_oaep_md:sha256 -pkeyopt rsa_mgf1_md:sha256
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/tmp/pitari-keyiv.bin').read_bytes()
assert len(b)==48
Path('/tmp/pitari-k').write_text(b[:32].hex())
Path('/tmp/pitari-i').write_text(b[32:].hex())
PY
openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -K "$(cat /tmp/pitari-k)" -iv "$(cat /tmp/pitari-i)" -in /tmp/pitari-source.enc -out /tmp/pitari-source.tgz
ACTUAL_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/pitari-source.tgz | awk '{print $1}')
test "$ACTUAL_SHA" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
rm -rf /tmp/pitari-app
mkdir -p /tmp/pitari-app
tar -xzf /tmp/pitari-source.tgz -C /tmp/pitari-app
test -f /tmp/pitari-app/package.json
echo "PITARI_SOURCE_STATE=VERIFIED"
echo "PITARI_SOURCE_SHA256=${ACTUAL_SHA}"
rm -f /tmp/pitari-cm-private.pem /tmp/pitari-key.enc /tmp/pitari-keyiv.bin /tmp/pitari-k /tmp/pitari-i /tmp/pitari-source.enc /tmp/pitari-source.b64 /tmp/pitari-ready.json

data.name: Validate TypeScript and Expo project
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/pitari-app
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.9.0 --activate
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm doctor
echo "PITARI_VALIDATION=PASS"

data.name: Set next TestFlight build number and prebuild iOS
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/pitari-app
LATEST=$(app-store-connect get-latest-testflight-build-number "$APP_STORE_APPLE_ID" 2>/dev/null || echo 6)
case "$LATEST" in ''|*[!0-9]*) LATEST=6 ;; esac
NEXT=$((LATEST + 1))
export PITARI_BUILD_NUMBER="$NEXT"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['expo']['version']=='1.0.0', d['expo']['version']
d['expo'].setdefault('ios',{})['buildNumber']=os.environ['PITARI_BUILD_NUMBER']
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
pnpm exec expo prebuild --platform ios --clean --no-install
cd ios
pod install
printf '%s' "$NEXT" > /tmp/pitari-build-number
echo "PITARI_NEXT_BUILD=${NEXT}"

data.name: Fetch and apply App Store signing files
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
keychain initialize
app-store-connect fetch-signing-files "$BUNDLE_ID" --type IOS_APP_STORE --create
keychain add-certificates
cd /tmp/pitari-app/ios
xcode-project use-profiles --custom-export-options='{"testFlightInternalTestingOnly": true}'

data.name: Build signed IPA
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/pitari-app
WORKSPACE=$(find ios -maxdepth 1 -name '*.xcworkspace' -print -quit)
test -n "$WORKSPACE"
SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -workspace "$WORKSPACE" -list -json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['workspace']['schemes'][0])")
test -n "$SCHEME"
xcode-project build-ipa --workspace "$WORKSPACE" --scheme "$SCHEME"
IPA=$(find build/ios/ipa -type f -name '*.ipa' -print -quit)
test -n "$IPA"
echo "PITARI_IPA_BUILT=YES"
echo "PITARI_BUILD_NUMBER=$(cat /tmp/pitari-build-number)"
